check_id.description: Stable slug, e.g. design.tokens.raw_color or portal.scoping.buyer_isolation

verdict.description: needs_env means unverifiable from here, never closed by assumption

severity.description: Impact if unaddressed. Passes carry info.

category.description: What kind of problem this is

surface.description: Page route, function name, entity, or file path the check targeted

evidence_path.description: File and line, request id, or record id backing the observation

status.description: Operator triage state, set in the UI, not by the harness

first_seen_run_id.description: Earliest run in which this check_id and surface failed

page_key.description: ProgressPage this finding belongs to. Set for findings raised in the Progress Control Center; blank for whole-app static checks.

origin.description: Who raised it. AI output is never treated as fact without evidence.

title.description: Short statement of the problem, for the findings list

description.description: Longer write up in the reporter's own words

finding_type.description: Workflow classification, distinct from the machine category field

priority.description: P0 is a migration or production blocker. Any open P0 caps the migration recommendation at not ready.

confidence.description: How sure the reporter is. Low confidence findings must be marked requires_verification.

evidence_type.description: Observation versus inference. inference and unknown never count toward evidence coverage.

requires_verification.description: Set when the claim is not yet backed by evidence. Such findings are displayed as unconfirmed and excluded from blocking gate maths.

acceptance_criteria.description: What would prove this finding resolved

open_question.description: A question only Nick's business knowledge can answer

thread_id.description: ReviewThread this finding was converted from

change_request_id.description: ChangeRequest raised to fix this finding

verification_evidence.description: What proves the fix, once status is fixed
